versions.subject: Merge PR #4767 from @frack113 - Update additional rules to use the `windash` modifier
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\replace.exe'
argument:
    CommandLine|contains|windash: '-a'
condition: selection and argument
versions.spl: Image="*\\replace.exe" CommandLine="*-a*" OR CommandLine="*/a*" OR CommandLine="*–a*" OR CommandLine="*—a*" OR CommandLine="*―a*"
